$$
\sin(u+v)=\sin u\cos v+\cos u\sin v.
$$

$$
\cos\left(\frac{7\pi}{4}\right)=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},\qquad \sin\left(\frac{7\pi}{4}\right)=-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}.
$$

Substitute $u=x$ and $v=\frac{7\pi}{4}$, then simplify the coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sin\left(x+\frac{7\pi}{4}\right)&=\sin x\cos\left(\frac{7\pi}{4}\right)+\cos x\sin\left(\frac{7\pi}{4}\right)\\
&=\sin x\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)+\cos x\left(-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)\\
